name: tank-artillery
description: Turn-based multiplayer artillery tank game (Phaser 3 + Socket.IO)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
